payload.rationale: Cycle 2 collapses planning into one executable capability backed by existing Issue 60, because no new work items may be created and a multi-issue shadow hierarchy would not be enforceable. The single issue has ordered, artifact-backed gates: freeze a finite repository snapshot and produce a disposition ledger; integrate only substantive unique histories without destructive rewriting; include the next unused SemVer (0.2.2) and immutable-release workflow hardening in the candidate; validate and independently review the exact pushed SHA; then govern PR merge, immutable tag/release publication, and exact-artifact verification. The canonical production outcome is the repository's configured GitHub/Burrito release artifact set: .bos/project.yaml names no runtime provider, server, project, URL, identity oracle, or rollback target, while burrito-release.yml is the only production channel and already builds and smokes four platform binaries. Therefore browser/server/runtime probes are deterministically not applicable unless implementation discovers a durable pre-existing BOS target before the irreversible boundary; discovering one would require a Goal scope/window decision rather than silently inventing a contract. Cross-repository Goal acancelas/bos-mcp#216 is coordination-only; all mutations remain in acancelas/symphony through bos-mcp/game-api.

capabilities.title: Consolidate Symphony and publish one verified immutable release
capabilities.context: Goal 59 is the Symphony repository slice of central BOS Goal 216. Current origin/main is d5c51b4b225c0b4b4335556eccbc0a1ab3850549 at immutable tag v0.2.1; numerous divergent origin refs contain unique commits, and local Symphony worktrees include issue/recovery branches. The prior execution plan assumed consolidation was complete, but cycle-1 review disproved that assumption. The repository has no configured continuously running production target; its canonical provider workflow is .github/workflows/burrito-release.yml, which builds and smoke-tests linux_x86_64, linux_arm64, macos_x86_64, and macos_arm64 binaries and publishes a GitHub Release.
capabilities.expectedOutcome: Every substantive unique Symphony history in the frozen inventory is explicitly integrated or dispositioned without destructive cleanup; one clean pushed candidate containing version 0.2.2 and fail-closed immutable release behavior passes exact-SHA validation and independent review; that exact candidate is merged through the governed PR path and published once as immutable tag/release v0.2.2 with four checksum-verified, clean-install-smoked platform artifacts and durable BOS evidence.
scope: At execution start record cutoff timestamp, origin/main SHA, complete local Symphony worktree roots, local refs, origin refs, ref tips, ahead/behind counts, dirty/untracked status, and unique commits in a durable provenance/disposition ledger attached to the run

Classify every unique history as substantive-integrate, already-equivalent, superseded-with-evidence, duplicate, generated/audit-only, or intentionally excluded by Goal scope; preserve source ref/commit and rationale
Integrate substantive changes onto one issue branch with ordinary merges/cherry-picks or conflict resolutions; never force-push, reset away, delete, or mutate source histories

Resolve semantic overlap across orchestrator, GameApiTrackerAdapter, outbox/audit, Goal authorization, workspace recovery, cancellation/subprocess, telemetry, dashboard, tracker, and release paths while preserving AGENTS.md security and durability boundaries
Set elixir/mix.exs version to the unused next SemVer 0.2.2 before candidate validation
Change the release workflow before candidate validation so existing tag/release/assets fail closed and assets are never uploaded with --clobber
Push the candidate normally and bind validations, reviews, evidence, PR, merge request, tag, release, artifacts, and checksums to exact immutable commit identities

Run targeted/spec gates, the required project test command, make all, clean-tree/upstream reachability checks, child-process leak scan, release workflow tests, and four-platform Burrito build/smoke checks in cost-ordered sequence

Obtain functional/quality and architecture/security reviews; add concurrency/recovery reviewer for affected scheduler/outbox/workspace code and release reviewer for workflow/version changes; visual/browser review is not applicable absent UI changes and a configured browser target

Use bos-mcp/game-api exclusively for durable Delivery/provider operations; merge without bypass, create v0.2.2 once, verify GitHub Release artifacts/checksums/install-smokes, and record exact-revision evidence
outOfScope: Creating new capabilities or work items during this analysis cycle
Mutating acancelas/bos-mcp Goal 216 or any sibling repository
Deleting worktrees, source branches, commits, untracked data, or unrelated user changes
Force-push, history rewriting, direct GitHub REST/GraphQL/gh provider operations outside the governed release workflow, or credential exposure to Codex
Inventing a daemon/server/browser production target not present in BOS or repository configuration
Unrelated product expansion, acceptance-criterion weakening, mutable/reused tags, release asset replacement, or unbounded repair
acceptanceCriteria: A durable ledger freezes the inventory universe at one cutoff and accounts for every local Symphony worktree/ref and every origin ref tip with objective disposition, source identity, and rationale
All histories marked substantive are present in the candidate or have exact equivalence/supersession evidence; no source history or unrelated state is destroyed or force-updated
The candidate includes version 0.2.2 and release workflow behavior that rejects any pre-existing tag/release/assets and never uses --clobber

The exact clean pushed candidate SHA passes targeted tests, cd elixir && mise exec -- mix specs.check where available, cd elixir && mise exec -- mix test, the repository make all gate, security-boundary assertions, subprocess leak scan, and release build/smoke verification

Risk-adaptive independent reviews pass on the exact candidate: functional/quality and architecture/security always; concurrency/recovery when those paths changed; release workflow/version review always; visual/browser only if a UI change and configured target are both present
A governed PR merges the exact reviewed/evidenced SHA without bypass; merged main identity is recorded before tagging

Unused immutable tag/release v0.2.2 points to the exact merged commit, contains all four platform binaries and SHA-256 files, and the published artifacts pass checksum and clean-install smoke verification

Durable BOS receipts cover inventory ledger, candidate evidence, reviews, PR/checks/merge, tag/release and post-publication artifact verification; Goal completion is not inferred from Issue or PR closure alone

If any pre-existing canonical runtime target is discovered before publication, execution pauses for an explicit versioned scope decision defining provider, identity oracle, probes and rollback rather than silently changing this artifact-release contract

issues.title: Reconcile, verify and publish the consolidated Symphony release
issues.context: Existing Issue 60 is the sole executable work item. Its earlier claim that integration was already complete is treated as stale: execution begins with a bounded inventory captured from the Symphony repository/worktree roots and all refs at a fixed cutoff. Ordered handoff artifacts within this issue are the inventory/disposition ledger, candidate provenance map, exact-SHA validation/review bundle, and release verification receipt.
issues.expectedOutcome: Issue 60 executes the complete gated sequence from finite history inventory through immutable v0.2.2 artifact publication, with every handoff exact-SHA-bound and auditable.
scope: Gate 1 inventory: freeze cutoff and emit complete provenance/disposition ledger
Gate 2 integration: reconcile substantive histories and preserve every source
Gate 3 candidate: include 0.2.2 version bump and immutable-release fail-closed workflow
Gate 4 assurance: push normally, run exact commands/applicability matrix, collect exact-SHA evidence and risk-adaptive reviews, and perform at most two strictly-derived repair cycles
Gate 5 delivery: governed PR/check/merge, unused immutable v0.2.2 tag/release, four-platform artifact/checksum/install-smoke verification and durable terminal projection
outOfScope: Assuming a named consolidation branch is complete without ledger evidence
New work items or cross-repository mutations
Destructive cleanup, force operations, stale evidence, check bypass, mutable release assets, invented runtime deployment, or unrelated fixes
acceptanceCriteria: Gate 1 cannot pass until every in-universe worktree/ref is represented in the ledger and the inventory cutoff is immutable
Gate 2 cannot pass until every substantive entry is integrated/equivalent/superseded with exact evidence and source histories remain intact
Gate 3 cannot pass until version 0.2.2 and no-clobber/fail-if-existing release behavior are part of the candidate
Gate 4 cannot pass until the exact pushed candidate is clean, upstream-reachable, all applicable commands pass, no owned child process leaks remain, and all required exact-SHA reviews/evidence pass
Gate 5 cannot start before Gate 4; merge, tag and release identities must converge on the same reviewed commit

Post-publication verification confirms all four platform artifacts and checksum files exist, hashes match, clean-install smoke behavior passes, release metadata is immutable, and BOS records the exact receipt

dependencies.rationale: This is the sole executable capability. Cross-stage dependencies are enforced inside Issue 60 as ordered artifact/SHA gates: inventory -> integration -> candidate hardening/versioning -> exact-SHA assurance -> merge/tag/release verification.

risks.mitigation: Freeze and retain a complete ledger; prohibit deletion, reset, force-push and source mutation; preserve dirty/unreadable worktrees.
Per-entry provenance, conflict-specific tests, full repository gates, exact-SHA functional/quality and architecture/security reviews, and no more than two strictly-derived repair cycles.
Freeze the universe at execution-start cutoff across named Symphony roots and all local/origin refs; later refs are a scope change, not an endlessly moving target.
All Delivery/provider state uses bos-mcp/game-api; host secrets remain outside Codex and direct provider access is prohibited.
Review repository fencing, rate-limit circuits, immutable claims, outbox chain/watermark recovery, isolated test outboxes, workspace preservation and OS-child reaping wherever touched.
Put 0.2.2 bump and release hardening in candidate before assurance; reject existing tag/release/assets; exact-SHA bind all gates; never clobber.
Use the only configured canonical target—GitHub/Burrito artifacts—with four-platform checksum/install-smoke verification; require a new decision if a real runtime target is discovered.
Treat bos-mcp Goal 216 as read-only coordination context; mutate only acancelas/symphony.
